senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. גרר) to scrape, sweep, esp. to remove ashes and coal from the stove; to scrape together, collect.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 8:11">Kel. VIII, 11</cite> <he>היתה גוֹרְפָתוֹ</he> if while she was sweeping it (the stove) &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 3:1">Sabb. III, 1</cite> <he>עד שיִגְרוֹף</he> not before he has swept it.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 7:3:14">Y. Peah VII, 20ᵇ</cite> top (ref. to <cite ref="Joel 1:17">Joel I, 17</cite>) <he>תחת שהיינו גוֹרְפִים וכ׳</he> in place of collecting honey (from beehives or trees), we collected foul matter.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 17:2">Sabb. XVII, 2</cite> <he>לִגְרוֹף בה וכ׳</he> to grab with it the figs out of the barrel; a. fr.—
Gen. R. s. 67 גּוֹרֶפֶת מחוטמה blowing her nose (v. גָּרַר).—Part. pass. גָּרוּף, f. גְּרוּפָה cleared of ashes &c., swept.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 3:4">Sabb. III, 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="A02181"><he>אַנְטִיכִי</he></cite>; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 53">Gen. R. s. 53</cite> <he>ג׳ מביתו של וכ׳</he> (Isaac is) the refuse of &c., comment.; v., however, <cite ref="C01310"><he>גְּרוֹף</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Keritot 7b">Kerith. 7ᵇ</cite>; Y. Snh. VII, 25ᵇ top, v. <cite ref="C00237"><he>גָּדַף</he></cite>
